description: This file defines the DateTime class within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\NumberFormat\Wizard namespace. The class extends DateTimeWizard and provides functionality for constructing date-time format strings with specified separators and format blocks, including methods for mapping format blocks and generating the final format string.

classes.name: DateTime
classes.description: A class used to create formatted date-time strings with customizable separators and format blocks, extending DateTimeWizard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a DateTime object with specified separators and format blocks, initializing internal arrays accordingly.

methods.name: mapFormatBlocks
methods.description: Maps each format block to a string, wrapping literals and converting objects as needed.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the final date-time format string by concatenating formatted blocks with separators.
